correctness.rationale: Every element of the maximal ideal is p-nilpotent by Frobenius, so arbitrary nilpotent generator images define a unique algebra map, and invertible cotangent linear part characterizes automorphisms via Nakayama. Split an idempotent cotangent projection into image and kernel and lift u_i=π(a_i), v_j=b_j−π(b_j), yielding conjugacy to P_r. To count embedded rank-r images, divide all cotangent-independent r generating tuples (prod_i(q^m−q^i)) q^{r(p^m−1−m)} by |Aut(A_r)|=|GL_r(q)| q^{r(p^r−1−r)}. This gives [m choose r]_q q^{r(p^m−p^r−m+r)} images. Each image has q^{(m−r)(p^r−1)} splittings by arbitrary images of omitted generators in its augmentation ideal. Degrees compare as delta_{m,r}=r(p^m−p^r)+(m−r)(p^r−1), and their difference changes sign exactly at m=p+3. Verified rank 0,m contribute one; finite checks do not claim proof for all p,m.

originality.rationale: Carlson–Friedlander–Pevtsova Proposition 1.1 directly covers cotangent-independence/flatness of truncated polynomial subalgebra embeddings, so this ingredient is prior. This work additionally classifies unital algebra idempotents by conjugacy, enumerates *all* embedded image subalgebras and distinct splitting maps over F_q, and identifies asymptotic top-rank reversal; none is stated by the inspected earlier proposition. Other pre-endomorphism work treats general nonassociative algebra and different maps. PASS qualified by possible earlier endomorphism-monoid enumeration.
